classification: Design/API and test scaffold only; independent component, no runtime wiring, no production identity or launch claim

Config: IntegrationID string exact existing canonical productID ^pid_[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$
Endpoint string HTTPS origin with optional explicit port; no user/query/fragment/path except optional slash
ClusterUID string canonical nonzero lowercase UUID
Audience string bounded exact nonempty ASCII
ReviewerCredentialFile string absolute protected current-user regular0600 singlelink file, no symlink, bounded ASCII bearer; reread each Verify
Issuer string exact operator-selected HTTPS issuer, may differ provider endpoint; no user/query/fragment
exports.RequestBinding: RequestID exact canonical pid_UUIDv4; Method HTTP token; ExactTarget exact origin-form path/query with no fragment/control; BodySHA256 lowercase64hex
exports.Proof: private cloned token bytes + binding; NewProof([]byte,RequestBinding)(Proof,error); token ASCII bounded16KiB, no JWT claim decode before TokenReview. String/GoString/Format always redacted, no accessor.
Verifier: Ready(context.Context)error local configuration/reviewer file checks only, no providerIO

transport: stdlib HTTPS only; explicit CA with original hostname/IP SAN validation, Proxy nil; no custom RoundTripper or clock; each dial checks every DNS answer against configured CIDRs before dialing exactly one sorted pinned IP, no retries/redirects/positive cache. Explicit ports allowed for provider origins and TLS protocol fixtures. Child context <=5s across ALL13 calls; response max TokenReview64KiB, object1MiB, aggregate12MiB+64KiB. Close bodies; no provider errors/raw body/token in returned errors.
protocol: POST TokenReview with exact opaque token and audiences=[configured]. Require authenticated true/noerror/audience includes configured/user exact system:serviceaccount namespace name/UID/exactlyone pod-name+pod-uid extras. Only then canonical JWT segments+strict payload exp integer future/sub/kubernetes.io namespace/serviceaccount name UID/pod name UID match authenticated review. JWT iss must equal configured Issuer; aud string or string-array must include configured audience after actual TokenReview.
object_policy: Unknown Kubernetes fields allowed, all JSON UTF8/escape surrogate integrity, exact duplicate keys, type-safe selected paths, bounded nesting. Case alias rejection scoped to actual security object fields, never arbitrary labels/annotations/extra-map extension keys. No raw TokenReview echo storage/logging. Explicit apiVersion/kind, immutable UID/currentname/namespace/deletion checked. SA, Pod, RS, Deployment, Node and kube-system read twice. Single controller apps/v1 RS then Deployment. Deployment zasp.ai/entity-kind=agent BOTHreads; both RS/Deployment pod-template SA match reviewed SA (omitted maps default). Pod actual nodeName -> Node actual UID+boot canonicalUUID. All13 stable security facts; resourceVersion alone may change. Pod status.phase must equal Running BOTH reads.
output: ObservedAt real systemUTC microseconds AFTER final read; tokenexpiry real JWT Unixseconds; ExpiresAt min(exp, observed+5s), deny expired/canceled at output. FactsSHA256 sha256 domain zasp-kubernetes-pod-facts-v1 newline then deterministic JSON struct containing output facts, observation/expiry and request binding, never rawtoken or reviewersecret. Facts are gateway observed testimony, not detached Kubernetes signed proof.
not_included: root configuration or runtime proxy activation
baseline: Unexecuted by author. Stub New/NewProof/Verify/Ready fail closed. Root actual positive TLS13-chain RED required before product implementation. Negative stub passes do not prove guards.
successor_reason: Root confirmed existing domain canonical product ID pid_UUIDv4 for IntegrationID and RequestID, distinct from provider UUIDs; final pre-RED successor.
